# GitHub Copilot instructions

Before changing this repository, read:
- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/HANDOFF.md`
- The relevant `docs/*.md` device, architecture, recovery, and test documents
- The relevant `agent/*.md` task playbook

The repository is agent-operated: execute and verify commands when the environment provides access; never claim unexecuted work is complete. Factory reset is disaster recovery only and requires explicit user approval. See `AGENTS.md` for the authoritative safety rules and definition of done.
